Class EmployeeView.Employee

java.lang.Object
com.squad83.views.EmployeeView.Employee
Enclosing class:
EmployeeView
public static class EmployeeView.Employee extends Object
Model class representing a single row of the employees table. Most fields are stored as JavaFX properties so the table can bind to them.
Author:
Squad 83

  • Constructor Details

    • Employee

      public Employee(int id, String firstName, String lastName, String role, String pin, double wage, LocalDate hireDate, boolean active)
      Creates an employee with the given values.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique employee ID
      firstName - the first name of the employee
      lastName - the last name of the employee
      role - the role of the employee, such as manager or cashier
      pin - the 4-digit PIN of the employee, as text
      wage - the hourly wage of the employee
      hireDate - the date the employee was hired
      active - whether the employee is currently active
